item.title: Robeline officials remind residents burn ban remains in effect amid dry conditions
item.description: Village officials are reminding residents that a town-wide burn ban remains in effect for the Municipality of Robeline due to ongoing extreme heat and dangerously dry conditions. According to the Village of Robeline, the burn ban was declared Feb. 26 by Mayor Gordon O’Con under the authority of Louisiana Revised Statute 29:727. item.description: The Natchitoches Parish School Board has introduced a new monthly recognition program highlighting outstanding employees across the district.
